title: Fix Render Order of Tooltips
description: Renders tooltips above all other elements.
body:
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2fd5b95540683053ee5783fa614414bb53326f7e.png)

Changes the rendering order of the tooltips so they don't get obstructed by other elements.

This fixes the issue where Fancy Menu elements would render on top of tooltips, it could also fix other mods too.
